text: {"headline": "EU refund amounts surged from 20 to 260 currency units between June and July 2026 while order volume remained flat at four orders per month.", "summary": "The increase was driven by a jump in refund frequency\u2014from 1 of 4 orders refunded in June to 3 of 4 in July\u2014and by larger individual refunds (90, 100, and 70 versus a single 20). All July refunds cited \u2018shipping_delay\u2019 as the reason, whereas the June refund cited \u2018size_issue.\u2019 The data shows an association between the shipping_delay reason and the higher refund total, but does not establish whether shipping delays actually caused the increase or whether the reason code was applied differently.", "contradictions": []}
